accessSummary: Kichijoji Station (JR Chuo Line / Keio Inokashira Line) North Exit: 8 min walk

rooms.name: Ambassador Room A/B (8F)
rooms.note: Ambassador Room divided into two. Classroom is 150 seats in the banquet hall list and 120 seats in the layout example on the individual page.

rooms.name: Oak Room A/B (7F)
rooms.note: Oak Room divided into two. The area column of the banquet hall list says 270㎡, while the heading and the individual page say 135㎡.

ops.parking: On-site, B2F, 26 standard cars (W 1.9m x L 3.3m to 5.0m x H 2.2m or less). Entry is possible 24 hours, except that entry is not possible from 24:00 to 6:00 the next morning (exit is possible); if you will enter after 24:00, you must contact the hotel. Rates: 3 hours free for banquets, 1 hour free for dining (5,000 yen or more); outside those, 700 yen per 30 minutes on weekdays and 800 yen per 30 minutes on Sat, Sun & holidays (tax included). For hotel guests, a 24-hour ticket is 2,500 yen at the front desk (no in-and-out).
ops.restaurants: In the building: Lounge & Dining SORAE (2F), Kisentei-Kichijoji (2F), Sushi-Ichiro (2F), and the bowling alley Dig Bowl Kichijoji (B1F).
